title: Foundry Artifact Record v1
description: Structural schema for one ArtifactRecord — a richer, Foundry-owned per-artifact record with integrity/checksum/versioning detail that specs/alchemist/v1/artifact-manifest.schema.json (Sprint 6) does not carry. This is a genuine extension, not a duplicate — see docs/bible/09-foundry/201-artifact-manifest-model.md for the exact reconciliation.

artifactVersion.description: PLANNED — no per-artifact-format version exists distinct from the exporter code itself.

byteSize.description: CURRENT as of Sprint 7 — computed via exporters/integrity.py::validate_non_empty(), though not yet threaded into any API response field.

checksum.description: CURRENT as of Sprint 7 for STEP/STL — sha256_checksum(), exposed via the X-Content-SHA256 response header. Not yet computed for JSON/specification exports.

generationDuration.description: PLANNED — no per-artifact timing exists; see docs/bible/08-alchemist/185-compiler-performance-model.md.
